notes.note: Reviewed the phone toolbar layout and shared tooltip floor against the Chrome fixtures. The wordmark can wrap past its clipped row, then the Station chip can ellipsize as the action cluster takes the remaining width. The Station tooltip and bell names retain the complete Station name and the exact pending count. The fixture checks center hit tests and the right gutter under capped-badge stress. The tooltip check renders the published kit primitive through NewChatAction and measures its computed 12px label.

Reviewed the shared stylesheet delta against its cited shell, responsive, theme, capture and feature claims. The mobile lockup grows into remaining space and retains its 22px logo floor and clipped wrap. Shared kit tooltip text now uses the existing 12px label token in both themes. The changed rules leave the cited dialog, dock, overlays, artwork, onboarding, provider and data contracts accurate.
